1. Finding out where the teleport is today
There are three variants of the world change. Each one has two possible server messages, which tell you where the teleport appeared.

Messages: *"A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the river near Drefia!"* or *"Near Drefia's mountains, a storm has revealed the entry to a nightmare that can't be sealed. Horrible creatures there spell instant death to all young adventurers who dare take a breath!"*. The teleport is near the {wiki:Plague Spike}, in the desert **west** of Darashia, by the river near Drefia.
Nightmare Coast — north of the Devourer

Messages: *"A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the northernmost coast!"* or *"Near Darashia's coast, a storm has revealed the entry to a nightmare that can't be sealed. Horrible creatures there spell instant death to all young adventurers who dare take a breath!"*. The teleport is in the north of the {wiki:Devourer (Geography)|Devourer}, on the coast **north** of Darashia.

Messages: *"A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the Ankrahmun tar pits!"* or *"In Ankrahmun's desert, a storm has revealed the entry to a nightmare that can't be sealed. Horrible creatures there spell instant death to all young adventurers who dare take a breath!"*. The teleport is in {wiki:Kha'labal}, in the desert **north** of Ankrahmun.

Go to the place indicated by the day's message (from Darashia or Ankrahmun, on foot through the desert) and enter the teleport. It takes you to the {wiki:Nightmare Isles|Nightmare Isles}: several platforms connected by magic stairs that work as teleports, like in the Roshamuul Cistern.
Hunting and looking for the Nightmare Teddy
On the islands, fearsome creatures guard a {item:Nightmare Teddy}. Fight your way through them to get a chance to obtain it.
{creature:Silencer|Silencers}, {creature:Retching Horror|Retching Horrors}, {creature:Choking Fear|Choking Fears} and {creature:Terrorsleep|Terrorsleeps} live here. Do not go in unprepared.
Chance to get a Nightmare Teddy

The wiki does not describe the way out of the islands. Go back up the same magic stairs to the platform where you arrived and look there for the way back to the Darama desert; then walk back to Darashia or Ankrahmun.
On some platforms there are more than ten creatures attacking you all at once: do not change platforms without enough health and mana, not even on the way back.
This mini world change has no Quest Log entry or NPCs.
